D2_T_01: [groggy] [mumbling] ...Where am I? [confused] [rising panic] Why is everything sliding?
D2_H_02: [worried] [over a crackling radio] Son! Can you hear me? [hopeful] Did you make it?
D2_T_03: [confused] I'm on a hill. [disgusted] The hill is greased. [nervous] Behind me there's... [pause] [terrified] a ship.
D2_H_04: [confused] A ship? On a hill? [alarmed] [shouting] Son, it's the 22nd of April! They're marching the ships over land!
D2_T_05: [panicked] [out of breath] [shouting while running] This bit was slower in the documentary!
D2_S_06: [surprised] Hey! [angry] [shouting] What are you doing on the slipway?! Move!
D2_H_WARRANTY: [urgent] [shouting] Two minutes left on the warranty! [worried] If you want to come back, it's now!
D2_H_WARRANTY_END: [sighs] The warranty's over. [firm] [urgent] Now just run.
D2_H_AFTER_WARRANTY: [flustered] The warranty's over. [determined] I'll think of something, hold on.
D2_H_RADIO_NO: [offended] Busy? [frantic] I'm sweating buckets over here!
D2_H_RADIO_YES: [relieved] [exhales] Phew. [warm] It's good to hear your voice. [urgent] Now run.
D2_T_STUMBLE_2: [panicked] [shouting] My fez! My fez fell off! [pause] [relieved] ...No, it's taped on.
D2_T_STUMBLE_2_NOFEZ: [panicked] [shouting] My tie! My tie's gone! [pause] [relieved] ...No, it's still there. [sighs] [deadpan] I'm the one who isn't.
D2_T_FALL: [nervous] [out of breath] The slope is ending... [terrified] [shouting] The slope has ended!
D2_T_08: [gasps] [spluttering] Water! [shivering] Cold! [teeth chattering] [indignant] The Golden Horn is cold in April!
D2_H_09: [calm] [thinking] There's a shore nearby, [worried] but there are soldiers too. [squinting] I can see a chain in the distance... [pause] [sheepish] Well, you can.
D2_T_CURRENT: [sheepish] I couldn't decide. [resigned] [sighs] The current decided for me.
D2_H_SWIM_HELP: [reassuring] Son, the current's carrying you. [chuckles] Just paddle, the Golden Horn will do the rest.
D2_H_SWIM_BOAT: [alarmed] [urgent] A boat's coming! [instructing] When it gets close, CTRL, son, [shouting] dive!
D2_H_SWIM_BOAT_2: [panicked] [shouting] Don't climb in, son, that's a patrol! [urgent] [hushed] Dive under it, don't let them see you!
D2_T_SWIM_NOAIR: [gasping for air] [panicked] No breath left! [out of breath] Breathe first, dive later!
D2_T_AMPHORA: [curious] An amphora down there... [intrigued] Maybe wine inside. [hesitant] Maybe thousand-year-old water. [firm] Not opening it.
D2_T_FEZ_FOUND: [overjoyed] [shouting] My fez! It found me! [thoughtful] Or I found it. [emotional] [sentimental] The Golden Horn reunited us.
D2_T_FEZ_SPARE: [surprised] A floating fez. [pleased] Now I have a spare. [proud] [chuckles] I am a man of two fezzes.
D2_T_10: [out of breath] [whispers] Nobody saw me. [relieved] Brilliant. [curious] Now... is this a market?
D2_HA_11: [suspicious] [squinting] Didn't a fez just slide down that hill?
D2_HA_11_NOFEZ: [suspicious] Didn't someone just slide down that hill? [puzzled] Someone in a frock coat?
D2_S_14_NOFEZ: [alarmed] [shouting] Seize him! [baffled] Is he mad or a spy?!
D2_T_15: [panicked] [pleading] I'm not a spy, [desperate] [shouting] I'm in insurance!
D2_H_17: [sheepish] [apologetic] We ran out of budget for this scene, son.
D2_H_19: [calm] [instructing] Walk toward the city. On the chain. [cautious] Keep your balance.
D2_T_22: [yelps] I slipped. [outraged] [shouting] Is the chain greased too?!
D2_T_ARROW_1: [terrified] [shouting] An arrow! They shot an arrow at me! [indignant] Who shoots an insurance agent?!
D2_T_ARROW_2: [shocked] It grazed the fez! [pause] [impressed] Turns out the fez is armour.
D2_T_ARROW_2_NOFEZ: [shocked] It grazed my hair! [shaky] If I'd had the fez on, the fez would be gone.
D2_T_ARROW_3: [nervous laugh] A warning shot, I guess. [shaky] [sarcastic] A very effective warning.
D2_H_24: [disappointed] That's it? [sighs] [wounded pride] I spent a year building that machine.
D2_T_25: [out of breath] Hikmet, can you hear me? [pause] [awed] [quietly] I'm... actually in 1453.
